author: National Geographic
description:
National Geographic Explorer and photographer Kiliii Yüyan visits an oyster farm on the Damariscotta River in Mid Coast Maine, an estuary with freshwater output and saltwater input, making it a great spot to farm oysters. On his visit, Kiliii learns more about the ways Maine's waterways have shaped the state. 

Catch up with Kiliii's adventures next week in our Maine Mondays series.
